purpose: Declared, counted, shrink-only list of module-level hexagonal inversions. Read by audit_engine::module_inversion_rule (ARCH-005). A new inversion fails the gate; an entry with no observed edge also fails, because paid debt left in the list hides that the list is stale.

rule.not_an_inversion: domain <-> ports. In hexagonal architecture the ports ARE the domain's interface: domain/shared.rs declares SubstrateDomainContract and domain/{services,privilege,packages,principal}.rs implement it. A Rust trait and its implementations cannot live in separate modules without mutual imports, so this is a language artifact, documented as permitted in crates/cynic-host/src/ports/mod.rs.
rule.growth: blocked -- a new identity, or a count above the recorded one, fails
rule.shrink: required -- an entry with no observed edge must be deleted

measured.note: Observation at ratification. Regenerated only by deliberate act.
